valgrim.name: Valgrim
valgrim.description: The wanderer the seers invoke. Men who believe he watches fight and learn with more confidence; his favour is the house's reputation for wisdom and nerve.

dunnar.name: Dunnar
dunnar.description: Protector of the common folk. A house in his favour has warriors who believe they cannot lose at home.

saltha.name: Saltha
saltha.description: The sea that feeds and drowns. Crews who trust her keep their heads in foul weather and read the water better.

fjorna.name: Fjorna
fjorna.description: Giver of plenty. Her favour stands for good fortune in fields, cradles and markets, and a reputation for open-handedness.

eidr.name: Eidr
eidr.description: Keeper of oaths and the holmgang square. A house known to honour him is trusted at the Thing and feared in single combat.

skell.name: Skell
skell.description: The outcast god of fire and tricks. Raiders who swear by him are bolder with torch and ruse, and luckier in wild gambles.

grayQueen.name: The Gray Queen
grayQueen.description: She who keeps the dead. Households that honour her keep the old customs of care, and weather plague and hunger with steadier hearts.
